# dokploy_github (Data Source)

Fetches a GitHub OAuth connection from Dokploy. GitHub providers can only be created via OAuth flow, but can be read via this data source.

## Example Usage

```hcl
# Look up GitHub provider by ID
data "dokploy_github" "main" {
  github_id = "abc123"
}

output "github_app_name" {
  value = data.dokploy_github.main.github_app_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `github_id` (String) The GitHub provider ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `git_provider_id` (String) The git provider ID.
- `github_app_id` (Number) The GitHub App ID.
- `github_app_name` (String) The GitHub App name.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier.
